description: This file contains functions related to managing and updating project version information within Drupal, including processing project info, calculating update statuses, and handling release data.

classes.name: ProjectCoreCompatibility
classes.description: Class used to handle core compatibility messages for projects.

methods.name: update_process_project_info
methods.description: Processes a list of projects to determine their installed versions, major versions, and install types.

methods.name: update_calculate_project_data
methods.description: Calculates the current update status for all projects, caching results and integrating core compatibility info.

methods.name: update_calculate_project_update_status
methods.description: Determines the update status for a specific project based on available releases and current version.
